title:
Return a descriptive invalid argument on branch mismatch (#11940)

## What changed?

`ValidateBranchTokenForExecution` now returns a plain `InvalidArgument`
with `request branchToken is not current.` when the request branch token
is not current. It does not attach server-only protobuf details.

## Why?

`CurrentBranchChanged` attaches a
`temporal.server.api.errordetails.v1.CurrentBranchChangedFailure` detail
to its gRPC status. HTTP gateways that do not link the server protos
cannot resolve that detail, so error marshaling fails and returns 500
instead of the InvalidArgument status the error carries. The detail is
not useful on this path because both versioned transitions are nil and
no caller consumes it.

## How did you test it?

- [x] `go test -tags test_dep ./service/history -run
'^TestEngineSuite/TestGetWorkflowExecutionHistory(Reverse)?_BranchTokenNotOwnedByExecution$'`
- [x] `make lint-code-fast`

The forward and reverse history tests verify that the result is
InvalidArgument, has the expected message, and has no protobuf details.

## Potential risks

`GetWorkflowExecutionHistory` and `GetWorkflowExecutionHistoryReverse`
callers that matched `CurrentBranchChanged` from this validation path
now receive InvalidArgument. The other HistoryService paths that return
`CurrentBranchChanged` are unchanged.
